attributes.has_name: Identify conditions that cause missed detection
attributes.task_description: Maintain the scenario catalog for Cases A, B, C1, C2, D and E, covering pose, resolution, contrast, concealment, glare and rain. Record combined conditions, complementary sensing, observable capability evidence and the required operator indication. Distinguish classifier generalization, suppression of usable fusion evidence, unavailable sensing information and a missed capability limitation. Keep no-fault scenario evidence separate from fault-injection results and avoid duplicate counting across linked cases.

attributes.has_name: Validate integrated detection for unusual poses
attributes.task_description: Exercise unusual poses across viewpoints and motion with the integrated sensor, fusion, classifier and warning chain. Measure missed detections and end-to-end warning delay against the system requirements. Correlate results with the linked SW classifier concern; record compensating mechanisms and remaining limitations.

attributes.has_name: Define and validate the combined sensing capability boundary
attributes.task_description: Determine the detection-performance boundary of the required RGB/lidar/LWIR combination for day, night and reduced visibility. Keep all three channels present and functioning; vary information quality and target geometry rather than injecting channel faults. Measure complementary modality performance and conditions where combined information remains insufficient. Include Case B small-target and Case C2 low-contrast scenarios. Specify the boundary and the required unavailable indication without authorizing reduced-sensor operation or treating darkness alone as a violation. Link results to TDS_SEN_005, TDS_SEN_007 and the environment requirements before accepting Case D.

Exercise combined rain, glare, obstruction, small apparent target size and thermal ambiguity with functioning sensors. Validate D-to-B only for small targets without adequate complementary resolution and D-to-C2 only for low thermal contrast without RGB/lidar compensation. Evaluate D-to-E separately by checking whether the capability assessment recognizes the limitation and produces the unavailable indication. Record the additional estimator insufficiency when it does not. The propagation arrows are conditional contributions, not AND gates or independent-event probability assumptions. Compare successful compensation and correct monitoring control scenarios; do not count the same missed detection multiple times.

attributes.has_name: Investigate classifier representation and pose coverage
attributes.task_description: Investigate whether representation or training-data coverage explains the observed pose-dependent misses. Propose changes and validate them using independent test data; do not assume that adding training samples establishes adequate performance.

attributes.has_name: Validate thermal benefit for camouflaged and partially concealed tigers
attributes.task_description: Compare the original RGB-plus-lidar configuration with the current RGB/lidar/LWIR chain on independent labelled camouflage and partial-concealment scenarios from Case C1. Evaluate missed detections, false alarms and end-to-end warning delay against TDS_SEN_007 and the referenced detection requirements. Sweep exposed target area, range, viewing geometry and target/background thermal contrast. Include opaque cover and the low-contrast conditions assessed in follow-up Case C2, including thermal crossover and sun-heated backgrounds. Verify the unavailable indication when the supported operating boundary is exceeded. Record evidence before accepting the residual risk; completion of the runtime measure does not close this validation task.

attributes.has_name: Evaluate classifier thresholds and temporal confirmation
attributes.task_description: Evaluate confidence thresholds and temporal confirmation using the unusual-pose inputs. Measure the tradeoff among missed detections, false alarms and detection latency. Link results to SWREQ_ALG_001 through SWREQ_ALG_005 and to integrated system Case A.

attributes.has_name: Validate the minimum apparent target size
attributes.task_description: Sweep target angular size, range, and viewpoint. Establish the validated sensing-resolution boundary and update requirements or restrictions where needed.
Evaluate thermal crossover and target/background contrast scenarios. Record residual limitations and complementary modality performance.

attributes.has_name: Validate thermal candidate retention under partial occlusion and clutter
attributes.task_description: Replay independent, synchronised and labelled RGB, lidar and LWIR observations through Fusion with all channels functioning correctly. Sweep exposed target area, vegetation clutter, viewpoint, range and corroboration strength while thermal contrast remains usable. Trace modality evidence, objectListOut candidate retention and timing, aligned sample availability and capabilityOut reporting. Include non-tiger thermal distractors to measure the false-alarm tradeoff. Compare the existing policy with SOTIF_RT_002, then validate missed detections and end-to-end warning delay with TigerDetectionApp in integrated system Case C1. Record compensation by any independent classification path. Keep opaque concealment and low thermal contrast as explicit boundary scenarios, including Case C2, without assuming thermal sensing can recover unavailable information. Attach results before closing the measure or accepting residual risk.

attributes.has_name: Preserve usable thermal candidates during fusion
attributes.task_description: Use condition-dependent fusion weighting and corroboration so a credible thermal-supported candidate is not rejected solely because RGB/lidar observations are inconclusive under partial occlusion and clutter. Preserve the candidate and its uncertainty for TigerDetectionApp classification. Retain status, freshness and association checks for every modality. If the validated detection capability cannot be established, report the limitation through capabilityOut for the unavailable-state decision. This measure does not authorize thermal-only operation or relax the required sensor set. Implement and validate the policy against SWREQ_SEN_004 and SWREQ_SEN_007; the runtime measure remains open.

attributes.has_name: Add thermal sensing and thermal-assisted tiger evaluation
attributes.task_description: Runtime measure derived from Case C1: provide a separate LWIR sensor and continuously use qualified thermal observations with RGB and lidar during operation. InfraredAcquisition supplies the thermal data and status, Fusion aligns and qualifies the evidence, and TigerDetectionApp evaluates it for tiger classification. Resulting requirements: TDS_SEN_003 (thermal acquisition) and TDS_SEN_007 (thermal-assisted evaluation), with SWREQ_SEN_007 defining the software contribution. Status: Done. The current system and software architecture includes the measure. Follow-up Case C2 assesses its limitation under low thermal contrast. Performance validation and residual-risk acceptance remain open and are tracked separately.

attributes.has_name: Validate capability monitoring and the unavailable indication
attributes.task_description: Validate SOTIF_RT_003 using independent sensing-performance ground truth and rain, glare, obstruction and combined low-contrast scenarios. Compare Case D with a correctly detecting monitor against Case D with the intended estimator limitations of Case E. Trace modality assessments through Fusion.capabilityOut, TigerDetectionApp and the operator unavailable indication. Measure false acceptance, false unavailable indications and timing against T_odd_violation and the applicable response requirement. Test unknown estimates and fresh but overoptimistic estimates separately. Document limits that cannot be reliably observed, including unknown-target contrast. Verify that ordinary nighttime operation does not trigger an unavailable indication solely because it is dark. Keep implementation-fault tests separate.

attributes.has_name: Define system-level detection performance acceptance tests
attributes.task_description: Define performance acceptance criteria for P_fn_close and P_fn_mid over the specified no-fault scenario space. Link each result to its concern and validation boundary.

attributes.has_name: Qualify operating capability against validated sensing limits
attributes.task_description: Refine the intended capability assessment using independent RGB, lidar and LWIR quality estimates and environmental evidence within their validated coverage. Do not equate fresh data or healthy acquisition with adequate detection capability. Unknown or insufficient evidence must not authorize a positive capability claim. When the validated boundary is exceeded or required capability cannot be established, Fusion shall report the limitation through capabilityOut for TigerDetectionApp to request the unavailable indication. Validate the complete monitoring and indication path against TDS_SAF_006, TDS_ODD_001 and the linked SW requirements. Preserve normal nighttime operation within validated limits; do not assume an unseen target has measurable thermal contrast or that this monitor can identify every classifier/fusion insufficiency. All three channels remain required. This measure reduces exposure to insufficient sensing; it cannot recover absent target information. Implementation and validation remain open.

Replay independent labelled fused samples and object hypotheses for unusual animal poses at the software component boundary, with qualified input status. Measure false negatives and detection delay across the required detection window; retain sample provenance and ground truth.
